blind.description: A stylized low-poly fantasy/rpg shop signpost made of warm brown wood with hand-painted textures. It consists of a vertical square wooden post with a pyramidal top, reinforced by a metal strap with rivets. An arm extends horizontally from the post supported by a curved wooden bracket, secured by a metal strap. Hanging from the arm via two short metal chain links is a rectangular wooden board made of planks depicting a painted purple and beige root vegetable (like a turnip or beet) with green leafy tops.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as an elongated rectangular profile consisting of a square post cap with a four-sided pyramid peak attached to a narrower horizontal wooden beam, with dark grey metal bands wrapping around both sections.
blind.height_vs_figure: The top of the wooden post stands slightly taller than the 5 ft 9 in figure (approx. 6.5 to 7 ft tall), with an arm width extending roughly 2.5 to 3 ft.
